gizmo.title: Tukutuku pūnaha rauropi
gizmo.description: He tukutuku pāhekoheko o te hononga o ngā wāhanga o tētahi kaupapa, me ngā tukutuku-iti me ngā haerenga ā-hipanga.

configure.title: Raraunga tukutuku
configure.description: Te URL o te paihere JSON o ngā tukutuku (i hangaia i PRAW, ecosystem-webs.json).

configure.title: Tukutuku
configure.description: Te ID o te tukutuku hei whakaatu tuatahi; ko main te tukutuku pūnaha rauropi.

configure.title: Taera kua tīpakohia
configure.description: Te ID o tētahi taera hei tīpako ina tuwhera te tukutuku.

configure.title: Haerenga
configure.description: Te ID o tētahi haerenga hei tīmata.

configure.title: Tīmata i te tirohanga rārangi
configure.description: Whakaaturia te tukutuku hei rārangi kōhanga, kaua hei tuhinga.

configure.title: Tuhinga anake
configure.description: Whakaaturia te tuhinga anake, hei whakaahua: kāore he pane, he haerenga, he taipitopito, he pae hipanga rānei.

advanced.title: Pānui mā
advanced.description: Tīmata me te pānui o ia taera mā te ine kotahi.
